deltas.title: Qwen3-only package and deterministic product surface
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove only if Vocello stops owning an in-tree Qwen3-specialized runtime.

deltas.title: Product generation contracts and structured completion
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove after upstream exposes equivalent typed finish, cancellation, and mode contracts.

deltas.title: Revision-aware prepared loading and bounded component caches
deltas.benchmarkEvidenceReason: Runtime convergence changed the measured source identity; the historical record remains a control, not verification of the current runtime.
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove only when an upstream loader provides the same revision, capability, trust, and cache contracts.

deltas.title: Text embedding read by row from the checkpoint file instead of loaded as a parameter
deltas.benchmarkEvidenceReason: Local fixed-seed A/B on the M6 (scripts/pcm_identity.py, seed 19790615; no published record): all 14 takes of the custom, design and clone matrix are PCM-identical on the Speed models and all 14 on the Quality models. One telemetry-on run each way: MLX active memory after load 1,271.6 MB to 956.3 MB (-315.3 MB, the table's size in the Speed checkpoint), the take's MLX peak 2,374.8 MB to 2,059.5 MB on Built-in Voice and 3,265.7 MB to 2,950.4 MB on Voice Cloning, the process footprint after a take 1,870 MB to 1,595 MB. No iPhone measurement exists yet.
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove if MLX gains file-backed or lazily paged parameters that keep an unread embedding table out of the process footprint, or if the text embedding stops being a pure row lookup.

deltas.title: Official talker and subtalker sampling with reusable hot-loop state
deltas.benchmarkEvidenceReason: Sampling algorithm v2 changes random-state ownership and requires fresh fixed-seed quality evidence.
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove individual optimizations only after upstream parity and deterministic waveform tests.

deltas.title: Request-local versioned MLX random state and independent subtalker policy
deltas.benchmarkEvidenceReason: Focused macOS and physical-iPhone Custom, Design, and Clone runs exercised request-local sampling v2 on the exact dirty worktree fingerprints; clean fixed-seed repeat controls and full-matrix promotion remain pending.
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove only after an upstream API carries versioned talker/subtalker policy and request-local reproducible random state without process-global mutation.

deltas.title: Float32 sampling logits and request-local reference-parity arms (RF-14)
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove the float32 cast only if upstream samples from float32 logits itself; full-text conditioning (D1, single streamed takes, RF-21) and EOS filtered like any token (D2, RF-18) are adopted, and each keeps its knob as the reverting arm; remove a knob once a recorded decision retires its comparison.

deltas.title: Bounded production streaming and final-audio barrier
deltas.benchmarkEvidenceReason: Focused macOS and physical-iPhone Custom, Design, and Clone classified-session runs passed on the exact dirty worktree fingerprints; clean repeated controls and full-matrix promotion remain pending.
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove only after upstream proves bounded retention, cancellation, ordering, and final barrier parity.

deltas.title: Persistent verified clone-prompt artifacts
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove only after a compatible upstream format supports atomic persistence and strict integrity.

deltas.title: Official Qwen speaker-feature frontend, mono-audio, and artifact-version contract
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove only after the runtime dependency provides numerically equivalent official Qwen speaker features, strict mono reference-audio normalization, validated embeddings, and version-bound artifact invalidation.

deltas.title: Clone reference trailing silence, selectable
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove the selection once the clone screen has decided A-12: keep only the adopted padding, raising codecEncodeConditioningVersion if it changes.

deltas.title: Single-owner generation gate and cancellation transfer
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove after upstream has equivalent FIFO ownership and transfer-race coverage.

deltas.title: Partition-invariant Mimi decoder and reset isolation
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove only after exact partition, reset, and timing parity passes against an upstream replacement.

deltas.title: Speech-tokenizer encoder rotary convention, selectable
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove the selection once the clone screen has decided A-02: keep only the adopted convention, with an encoder version in the speaker-feature identifier if the split-half convention becomes the default.

deltas.title: Speech-tokenizer decoder attention window, selectable
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove the selection once a screen of takes longer than the window has decided RF-54; if the window is adopted, bound the decoder's KV cache to the window as a separate, PCM-identical change.

deltas.title: Typed Qwen3 runtime diagnostics and signpost attribution
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove individual probes only after their validators and profile consumers are retired.

deltas.title: Vocello-owned engine actor, classified generation, and finalization boundary
deltas.removalCriteria: Retain as the shipping product-generation boundary even if the remaining load/prewarm compatibility bridge or implementation modules are later replaced.

deltas.title: The Qwen3 runtime's largest file split by concern (pure moves)
deltas.benchmarkEvidenceReason: No behaviour change to measure: Qwen3TTS.swift's 6,806 lines were moved, unchanged, into eight files (the generate loop and the model's core stay in Qwen3TTS.swift; loading, prompt assembly, sampling, the caches, the generation profiles, the voice-clone prompt and the diagnostic records each get a file), and 31 declarations went from private to internal because their users are now in another file. A script verified that every original line is present after the split; the fixed-seed PCM digests are unchanged.
deltas.removalCriteria: Not a behaviour delta: drop this entry only if the files are merged again or the per-file coverage rule no longer needs it.

deltas.title: Checkpoint configuration and text-processing compatibility
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove only when all pinned model artifacts adopt one verified upstream representation.

deltas.title: Per-pass compiled code-predictor execution for the streaming decode loop
deltas.benchmarkEvidenceReason: Same-day A/B on the exact pre-commit worktree: +8.3% to +10.6% warm RTF on every custom/clone cell with 12/12 fixed-seed byte-identity and a clean 12-seed QC soak; a clean canonical matrix can upgrade this status.
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove only if the streaming loop stops replaying a fixed per-frame code-predictor position sequence (which the pass-indexed traces require) or an upstream compiled equivalent ships.

deltas.title: Quality-first decode keeps every generated frame (explicit frame-count sample window)
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove only after upstream quality-first decode, in-context reference cut and codec replay derive their sample window from explicit reference and generated frame counts instead of counting non-zero first-group codes.

deltas.title: Talker rotary step in a sign-folded gather form (two kernel launches fewer per tensor per layer)
deltas.benchmarkEvidenceReason: Local fixed-seed A/B on the M6 against the optimized CLI of 3cf36192 (scripts/pcm_identity.py, seed 19790615; no published record): all 14 takes of the custom, design and clone matrix are PCM-identical on the Speed (4-bit) models, and all 14 on the Quality (8-bit) models. With the bench clamped to the efficiency cores, where the host bounds a frame, the rotary step alone is 1.8% faster and both launch reductions together 4.0% (three paired rounds: -3.8%, -4.5%, -3.0%; baseline round spread 0.1%). Unclamped, where the GPU bounds a frame, they are neutral (-0.4%, spread 0.3%) with 1.6% less host CPU. No iPhone measurement exists yet.
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove only if the talker's rotation moves to one fused kernel whose output is proven equal, or the talker stops applying rotary embeddings per layer.

deltas.title: One fused quantized product for the projections that share an input, on one-row steps
deltas.benchmarkEvidenceReason: Local fixed-seed A/B on the M6 against the optimized CLI of 3cf36192 (scripts/pcm_identity.py, seed 19790615; no published record): all 14 takes of the custom, design and clone matrix are PCM-identical on the Speed (4-bit) models, and all 14 on the Quality (8-bit) models. With the bench clamped to the efficiency cores, where the host bounds a frame, the rotary step alone is 1.8% faster and both launch reductions together 4.0% (three paired rounds: -3.8%, -4.5%, -3.0%; baseline round spread 0.1%). Unclamped, where the GPU bounds a frame, they are neutral (-0.4%, spread 0.3%) with 1.6% less host CPU. No iPhone measurement exists yet.
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove if MLX's one-row quantized kernel stops computing each output row independently of the output width (the fixed-seed PCM digests would then differ), or if the pinned MLX gains a fused multi-projection product.

deltas.title: The code predictor's frame runs as one compiled function that samples, on keys the request resolves
deltas.benchmarkEvidenceReason: Local fixed-seed A/B on the M6 (scripts/pcm_identity.py, seed 19790615; no published record). PCM-identical on 39 takes (14 Speed, 14 Quality, 8 with instruct-bearing deliveries, 3 long). Two steps, each against the build before it. Sampling inside the passes (0dc10a5a): 6.3% faster with the bench clamped to the efficiency cores, where the host bounds a frame (three paired rounds: -6.6%, -6.1%, -5.9%), and 0.5% faster unclamped with 5.3% less host CPU. The frame as one function, with the embedding sum: a further 2.3% clamped (-0.4%, -3.0%, -2.6%; baseline spread 1.1%) and 0.3% unclamped (-0.4%, -0.6%, +0.3%; spread 0.2%). Warm first-chunk latency unchanged. Identity is measured, not proven: MLX fuses elementwise chains into one kernel, which could round differently on another MLX or GPU; the digests are the guard. No iPhone measurement exists yet.
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove if the fixed-seed PCM digests differ from the eager sampler's on a supported device or after an MLX move, or if the subtalker stage stops being the plain temperature and top-k sampler.

deltas.title: AudioSeal watermark generator port (EU AI Act Article 50 marking)
deltas.benchmarkEvidenceReason: Numerical parity is the governing evidence: whole-buffer output matches the PyTorch reference (facebookresearch/audioseal, audioseal 0.2.0 package = GitHub a0ce2564ff2b, MIT; weights facebook/audioseal generator_base.pth, LFS SHA-256 7a845b5fbe93, identical at every revision; reconstructed 2026-09-24 from public metadata, see ORIGINS.md) at >=40 dB SNR on committed-protocol fixtures, the exact-streaming windowed path matches whole-buffer at >=55 dB, and the reference detector scores Swift-marked real speech 1.0000 with the fixed 0x56C0 payload decoding exactly (CP-2 stage-2 evidence, 2026-08-06). Memory-qualified benchmarks arrive with the publication-seam integration.
deltas.removalCriteria: Remove only if Vocello adopts a different Article 50 marking layer or upstream mlx-audio-swift ships an equivalent watermark generator.
